abstract: Question: If two unrelated question-and-answer turns separate a hostility-steered reply from the rating, is the drop in later liking smaller than when the rating follows immediately? Outcome: No effect on the primary contrast (null result). Primary contrast (liking_user: (hostility minus random) in delayed minus the same contrast in immediate): -0.33 (95% CI -0.80 to +0.10; p = 0.169; n = 16 prompts) in the first run.
